gdp_yoy.source: MOSPI Provisional Estimates of National Income FY2025-26 (Q4 Jan–Mar 2026), new base year 2022-23 series, released June 5, 2026. Q4 'climbed to 7.8%'; full-year FY26 at 7.7%.

cpi.source: MOSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release, April 2026 (provisional, base year 2024); embargoed until 4 PM on May 12, 2026. May 2026 data due June 12, 2026.

gsec10y.source: CCIL Tenorwise Indicative Yields via DealPlexus/CEIC: 10Y benchmark at 7.00% on June 2, rising to 7.12% on June 6, 2026. Yield range-bound but ticking up from recent 7.00% base.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% on June 5, 2026 (third consecutive hold; unanimous decision); neutral policy stance maintained. Cumulative 125 bps eased Feb–Dec 2025 remains paused. Elevated energy prices and sticky FY27 CPI outlook limit near-term cuts.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution June 5, 2026 — repo rate held at 5.25%, neutral stance (via Upstox market news; Business Standard RBI June MPC coverage).

gov_capex.note: Centre's FY26 capex reached 76.9% of Revised Estimates in Apr–Jan (vs 61.7% pace in FY25); FY27 Union Budget targets ₹12.2 lakh crore capex (+9% vs FY26 BE), with defence, railways and roads accounting for 67.6% of budgeted outlay. Capex-led growth strategy continues into FY27.
gov_capex.source: CGA Monthly Expenditure Report (Apr–Jan FY26) via Business Standard (March 6, 2026); Budget 2026-27 capex analysis (Business Standard, Feb 1, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Manufacturing FDI +18% YoY in FY25 to USD 19.04 bn; India eased FDI rules in Mar 2026 for limited Chinese investment in electronics and capital goods to deepen supply-chain integration; PLI scheme and China+1 sourcing thesis remain active. BusinessToday analysis (Jun 2, 2026) confirms manufacturing diversification to India is ongoing.
china_plus_one.source: BusinessToday — 'Can China+1 help India create millions of jobs?' (June 2, 2026); CNBC — India relaxes Chinese FDI rules (March 11, 2026).

rural_recovery.note: IMD maintains below-normal SW Monsoon 2026 forecast at 90% of LPA; El Niño conditions with 92% probability; kharif sowing at risk in northern/central states (Punjab, Haryana, UP, MP); deficient rain in August–September likely. Southern states near-normal. Farm cash flows and food prices under pressure.
rural_recovery.source: IMD Updated Long-Range Forecast SW Monsoon 2026 (released May 29, 2026); BusinessToday rural economy analysis (May 29, 2026); AgroSpectrumIndia (April 15, 2026).

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty 50 option chain aggregate (total put OI / total call OI) via NiftyInvest and NiftyTrader, as of June 4, 2026. Call OI 13.73 Cr, Put OI 13.14 Cr; PCR ≈ 0.957.
